description:
Retype the issue ids that the shared integration-test harness returns and accepts.

## Background

Integration suites link the library with the `test-support` feature (`crates/jit/Cargo.toml:103`), so the shared canonical-id fixture in `jit::test_utils` is reachable. Their helpers take and return ids as `&str` or `String`, and assertions compare ids and dependency lists with strings; once ids are validated, those comparisons and conversions stop compiling. Hierarchy vector node ids model graph nodes, not issues. The shared harness (`crates/jit/src/test_harness.rs:108-224`, reached as `jit::test_harness`) returns created ids as `String` and takes `get_issue(&self, id: &str)`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The harness's issue-creating helpers return `IssueId`, and its id-taking helpers take `&IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Suite callers of the harness, which already pass `&IssueId`, compile unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: The shared integration harness carries typed issue ids
